entry.summary: Overseas France is outside the Schengen area: a Schengen visa doesn't cover it. Australians are reported visa-free for short stays (Smartraveller says so for French Polynesia and New Caledonia, 90 days in 180).
entry.next_check: Confirm the rule for this territory on France-Visas.

meetings.detail: Short tourist stays are visa-free; work needs a French visa and the territory's own work authorisation.
